title: How to Use Internet
description: Learn the fundamentals of internet usage.

materials.content: The internet is a global network connecting millions of computers and devices.

choices.comment: The internet connects much more than phones.
Correct! The internet connects devices around the world.
Websites are only one service on the internet.

questions.question: Which device can access the internet?

choices.comment: Correct! Laptops can connect to the internet.
A stone cannot access the internet.
Correct! Smartphones can access the internet.
Correct! Websites contain multiple webpages.
A website is not hardware.
Cables connect devices, not websites.

questions.question: Which program is commonly used to browse the internet?

choices.comment: Correct! Browsers like Chrome or Firefox are used to access websites.
Calculators are not used for browsing.
Paint apps are for drawing.

questions.question: What should you do before clicking an unknown link?

choices.comment: Unknown links may be unsafe.

choices.text: Check if the link is trustworthy
choices.comment: Correct! Always verify links before opening them.
That does not improve safety.
Wi-Fi is unrelated to cooking.

choices.text: Connecting devices wirelessly to the internet
choices.comment: Correct! Wi-Fi allows wireless internet access.
Wi-Fi does not charge devices.

choices.text: A tool used to find information online
choices.comment: Correct! Search engines help users find websites and information.
That is unrelated to the internet.
Monitors display images, not search results.

choices.text: They protect accounts and personal information
choices.comment: Correct! Strong passwords improve online security.
Passwords do not affect internet speed.
Passwords do not provide power.

questions.question: What should you do if a website asks for sensitive information unexpectedly?

choices.comment: Never share sensitive information carelessly.
Correct! Always confirm the site's authenticity.
You only need to be cautious, not avoid the internet entirely.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the internet?

choices.comment: Correct! The internet enables communication and information sharing.
Games are only one use of the internet.
The internet depends on electricity.
